name: Strength 3× a week
summary: Strength train three times a week with a progressive routine, set training days and planned lighter weeks.

onboarding.reaction: Perfect. We'll pick moves that fit your space.

onboarding.prompt: How much lifting have you done?
options: Regular for a year or more
onboarding.reaction: Good. We'll start where you are.

onboarding.prompt: Any injuries or moves to avoid?
Tap three training slots with a day between them.
onboarding.reaction: Three sessions placed, rest days protected.

phases.name: Learn the moves
actions: Full-body sessions: push, pull, squat, hinge, carry

phases.name: Progress
benchmarks: Add reps or load on main lifts most weeks

plan_blueprint.calendar: Three sessions a week on the chosen slots with a rest day between each; every fourth week is marked as a lighter deload week.

approach_variants.habit: Same three days every week, stacked on a regular cue (after work); session streak.
approach_variants.willpower: Monthly personal-best challenge on one lift, inside planned increases.
approach_variants.time: Each session is a calendar block with warm-up time; weekly minutes review.
approach_variants.resource: Week one gathers equipment or a gym pass, a simple log and a form-check video or coach.

guardrails: Talk to your doctor before starting. GoalKin offers education, not medical advice.
Stop any movement that causes sharp pain and get it checked before continuing.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
Product, app or recipe ideas are labeled as suggestions; any affiliate link is disclosed.
restart_rules: A missed session moves to the next free day if it keeps a rest day between sessions; otherwise it is skipped. After a missed week, the plan repeats the previous week at the same load. After two or more weeks off, loads drop back for one week.
